q: The main open problem about sofic groups is:
opts: Whether all groups are sofic (no non-sofic group is known to exist)
exp: The central open question: does there exist a non-sofic group? A non-sofic group would have no finite approximations whatsoever — a group that is fundamentally 'infinite' in nature. All known groups are sofic. Finding a non-sofic group (or proving all groups are sofic) is a major open problem.
